marketLayer.title: HK Tech Giants & Enterprise AI Monetization
marketLayer.fact: Major Hang Seng Tech constituents reported strong cloud revenue acceleration driven by enterprise generative AI deployment, accompanied by expanded share buyback announcements totaling over HKD 15 billion.
marketLayer.inference: Valuation multiples across Chinese internet leaders are likely to re-rate upward as AI capital expenditures begin yielding visible, high-margin software revenues rather than pure R&D drag.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustainability of foreign portfolio inflows and potential updates to cross-border data transfer regulations.

marketLayer.title: US Rate Cut Outlook & Macro Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: US core PCE price index printed in line with market expectations at 2.6% year-over-year, alongside a mild cooling in initial jobless claims, cementing interest rate cut bets for the upcoming FOMC meeting.
marketLayer.inference: A softer US dollar and declining benchmark Treasury yields provide immediate liquidity relief for high-duration US growth equities and emerging market risk assets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Resilience of non-housing services inflation and potential volatility in upcoming US non-farm payroll revisions.

marketLayer.title: Global Semiconductor & Advanced Packaging Chain
marketLayer.fact: Leading semiconductor foundries signaled sustained 100% capacity utilization for 2nm/3nm processes and advanced CoWoS packaging, supported by continuous capital expansion from major hyperscalers.
marketLayer.inference: Capital expenditure super-cycles among AI chip vendors will continue to trickle down into OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) companies and specialized wafer equipment manufacturers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Escalating geopolitical trade restrictions on advanced chip design tools and key raw material supply chains.

marketLayer.title: New Energy Vehicles & Margin Normalization
marketLayer.fact: HK-listed electric vehicle OEMs posted sequential margin recovery as lithium carbonate input prices stabilized around RMB 85,000/ton, while software subscription revenues for urban ADAS grew over 40% QoQ.
marketLayer.inference: Market competition is shifting from aggressive hardware price wars toward high-margin autonomous software features and international export expansion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Anti-subsidy tariff enforcement mechanisms in European export destinations and domestic demand friction.
